papers.abstract_original: We develop methods for inference following sequential experiments by studying the asymptotic properties of tests. We find that the large-sample power of any test can be matched by a test in a suitable limit experiment involving Gaussian diffusions. This establishes that a fixed set of statistics are asymptotically sufficient for testing; these are the number of times each treatment has been sampled and the final value of the score/efficient influence function process for each treatment. We also derive asymptotically optimal tests under various conditions and apply these findings to three types of sequential experiments: costly sampling, group sequential trials, and bandit experiments.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们通过研究检验的渐近性质，发展了序贯实验后进行推断的方法。我们发现，任何检验的大样本功效都可以由一个适当极限实验中的检验来匹配，该极限实验涉及高斯扩散。这确立了固定的一组统计量对于检验是渐近充分的；这些统计量是每种处理被抽样的次数以及每种处理的得分/有效影响函数过程的最终值。我们还推导了在各种条件下的渐近最优检验，并将这些发现应用于三种类型的序贯实验：有成本的抽样、成组序贯试验和老虎机实验。

papers.abstract_original: I characterize markups in the search-theoretic model of imperfect competition of Burdett and Judd. A formula for the equilibrium distribution of markups is derived, showing how fundamentals affect the level of markups and their relationship to sellers’ size. Anything goes theorems are derived, showing that any relationship between sellers’ size and markups can be obtained in equilibrium. When competition is exogenous, equilibrium is efficient despite positive and heterogeneous markups. When competition is endogenous, necessary and sufficient conditions for efficiency are derived. Interpreting equilibrium markups through the lens of the Dixit-Stiglitz model of monopolistic competition leads to incorrect conclusions about counterfactuals and welfare.
papers.abstract_zh: 我刻画了Burdett和Judd的不完全竞争搜寻理论模型中的加成率。我推导出加成率均衡分布的公式，展示了基本面因素如何影响加成率水平及其与卖方规模的关系。我推导出“一切皆有可能”定理，表明在均衡中可以得到卖方规模与加成率之间的任何关系。当竞争是外生的时，尽管加成率为正且异质，均衡仍是有效率的。当竞争是内生的时，我推导出效率的充分必要条件。通过Dixit-Stiglitz垄断竞争模型的视角来解读均衡加成率，会导致关于反事实和福利的错误结论。

papers.abstract_original: The mechanisms driving disparities in mental health care are not well understood. This paper develops a structural model of diagnosis for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), highlighting how patient and physician factors can result in disparities. Using electronic health record data, I estimate model parameters and decompose the observed male∶female ADHD diagnostic difference of 2.3∶1. Simulations show that only 20%–25% of this diagnostic difference can be explained by underlying symptom prevalence, with the majority driven by differences in diagnostic thresholds. I find that physicians view missed diagnosis to be costlier for their male patients, which I argue may have economic justifications.
papers.abstract_zh: 驱动精神卫生保健差异的机制尚未被充分理解。本文构建了一个注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）诊断的结构模型，强调患者和医生因素如何导致差异。利用电子健康记录数据，我估计了模型参数，并分解了观察到的男性∶女性ADHD诊断差异2.3∶1。模拟表明，这一诊断差异中只有20%–25%可以由潜在的症状患病率解释，其中大部分由诊断阈值的差异驱动。我发现医生认为漏诊对其男性患者代价更高，我认为这可能具有经济上的合理性。

papers.abstract_original: Rent guarantee insurance (RGI) provides tenants with insurance against nonpayment of rent. We introduce RGI in a quantitative equilibrium model of housing insecurity and show it increases welfare by improving risk sharing across idiosyncratic and aggregate states, reducing the need for large security deposits and reducing homelessness that imposes large costs on society. While unrestricted access to RGI is not financially viable because of moral hazard and adverse selection, restricting access can restore viability. Private insurers target better-off renters, while public insurers focus on households most at risk of homelessness. Stronger tenant protections increase the effectiveness of RGI.
papers.abstract_zh: 租金担保保险（RGI）为租户提供针对租金未付的保险。我们将RGI引入一个关于住房无保障的定量均衡模型，并表明它通过改善跨异质性和总体状态的风险分担、减少对巨额押金的需求以及减少给社会带来巨大成本的无家可归现象，提高了福利。虽然由于道德风险和逆向选择，不受限制地获得RGI在财务上不可行，但限制准入可以恢复其可行性。私人保险公司瞄准的是经济状况较好的租户，而公共保险公司则聚焦于最有可能无家可归的家庭。更强的租户保护会提高RGI的有效性。

papers.abstract_original:
We examine the intergenerational effect of education policy on crime. Using
administrative data that link outcomes across generations with crime records, we show that
the Swedish comprehensive school reform, gradually implemented between 1949 and 1962,
reduced conviction rates both for the generation directly affected and for their sons. The
reduction occurred across several types of crime. Mediation analysis suggests that the key
channels include increased parental educational attainment and household income, as well
as reduced criminal behavior among fathers.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察教育政策对犯罪的代际影响。使用将跨代结果与犯罪记录联系起来的行政数据，我们表明，在1949年至1962年间逐步实施的瑞典综合学校改革，降低了直接受影响的那一代人及其儿子的定罪率。这一下降发生在多种犯罪类型中。中介分析表明，关键渠道包括父母受教育程度和家庭收入的提高，以及父亲犯罪行为的减少。

papers.abstract_original: We propose a practical and robust method for making inference on average treatment effects estimated by synthetic controls. We develop a K-fold cross-fitting procedure for bias correction. To avoid the difficult estimation of the long-run variance, inference is based on a self-normalized t-statistic, which has an asymptotically pivotal t-distribution. Our t-test is easy to implement, provably robust against misspecification, and valid with stationary and nonstationary data. It demonstrates an excellent small-sample performance in application-based simulations and performs well relative to other methods. We illustrate the usefulness of the t-test by revisiting the effect of carbon taxes on emissions.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种实用且稳健的方法，用于对由合成控制估计的平均处理效应进行推断。我们开发了一种用于偏差校正的K折交叉拟合程序。为避免对长期方差的困难估计，推断基于自归一化t统计量，该统计量具有渐近枢轴t分布。我们的t检验易于实施，可证明对模型误设具有稳健性，并且在平稳和非平稳数据下均有效。它在基于应用的模拟中展现出优异的小样本表现，并且相对于其他方法表现良好。我们通过重新审视碳税对排放的影响来说明该t检验的实用性。

papers.abstract_original: An informed seller designs a dynamic mechanism to sell an experience good. The seller has private information about product match, which affects the buyer’s private consumption experience. The belief gap between both parties coupled with the buyer’s learning yields mechanisms providing the skeptical buyer with limited access to the product and an option to upgrade if the buyer is swayed by a good experience. Depending on the seller’s screening technology, this takes the form of free/discounted trials or dynamic tiered pricing, which are prevalent in digital markets. Unlike static environments, having consumer data can reduce sellers’ revenue in equilibrium.
papers.abstract_zh: 一个拥有信息的卖方设计一种动态机制来销售一种体验品。卖方拥有关于产品匹配度的私人信息，这会影响买方的私人消费体验。双方之间的信念差距加上买方的学习，产生了这样的机制：为持怀疑态度的买方提供有限的产品获取机会，以及一个在买方被良好体验说服时进行升级的选项。取决于卖方的筛选技术，这表现为免费/折扣试用或动态分层定价，这些在数字市场中十分普遍。与静态环境不同，拥有消费者数据在均衡中可能降低卖方的收入。

papers.abstract_original: We study the macroeconomic implications of asymmetric information in capital markets. We build a model in which heterogeneous capital is traded in illiquid markets, with sellers better informed about its quality than buyers. Asymmetric information distorts the terms of trade for sellers of high-quality capital, who list higher prices and accept lower trading probabilities to signal their type. Guided by the model, we measure these distortions from the relationship between listed prices and trading probabilities in a unique dataset of capital units. Combining this measurement with the model, we show that information asymmetries can play a quantitatively large role during crises, when they intensify.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究资本市场中信息不对称的宏观经济影响。我们构建了一个模型，其中异质性资本在非流动性市场上交易，卖方对其质量的了解优于买方。信息不对称扭曲了高质量资本卖方的贸易条件，这些卖方通过列出更高的价格并接受更低的交易概率来传递其类型信号。在该模型的指导下，我们利用一个独特的资本单位数据集，从列出的价格与交易概率之间的关系中度量这些扭曲。将该度量与模型相结合，我们表明信息不对称在危机期间可能发挥数量上巨大的作用，此时信息不对称会加剧。

papers.abstract_original: We study frictions in dealer intermediation in durable goods markets using iBuyers, technology-driven intermediaries providing liquidity through rapid algorithmic transactions. iBuyers earn positive spreads, bypass slow bilateral search, but operate primarily in liquid, easy-to-value segments. We develop and calibrate a dynamic search model where intermediaries face adverse selection from imperfect valuation. Faster transactions increase liquidity but reduce information, limiting intermediation. iBuyers offer a partial solution, enabling speed with limited information loss but only where assets are homogeneous and liquid. Extending the model across durable goods highlights how valuation difficulty, liquidity, and subjective value dispersion jointly determine the scope of intermediation.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用iBuyers研究耐用品市场中经销商中介的摩擦，iBuyers是通过快速算法交易提供流动性的技术驱动型中介。iBuyers赚取正价差，绕过缓慢的双边搜寻，但主要在流动性高、易于估值的细分市场中运营。我们开发并校准了一个动态搜寻模型，其中中介因估值不完美而面临逆向选择。更快的交易增加流动性但减少信息，从而限制中介。iBuyers提供了一种部分解决方案，在信息损失有限的情况下实现速度，但仅限于资产同质且流动性高的领域。将该模型扩展到耐用品领域，凸显了估值难度、流动性和主观价值离散度如何共同决定中介的范围。

papers.abstract_original: We provide new estimates of spillover effects of unions on nonunion wages. We work with a search and bargaining model, endogenizing union formation and including firm responses to unionization threats. Unions affect nonunion wages through a standard threat channel (firms raise wages to fend off unionization) and a bargaining channel (union jobs are part of worker outside options). Model estimates imply that deunionization accounts for a third of the decline in the US mean wage between 1980 and 2010, with half the effect due to spillovers. Both threat and bargaining channels are operational. The bargaining channel is more important.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提供了工会对非工会工资溢出效应的新估计。我们采用搜寻与谈判模型，将工会形成内生化，并纳入企业对工会化威胁的反应。工会通过标准的威胁渠道（企业提高工资以抵御工会化）和谈判渠道（工会工作岗位是工人外部选项的一部分）影响非工会工资。模型估计表明，去工会化解释了1980年至2010年间美国平均工资下降的三分之一，其中一半效应来自溢出效应。威胁渠道和谈判渠道都在发挥作用。谈判渠道更为重要。

papers.abstract_original:
We study policies that aim to “keep carbon in the ground” by blocking fossil fuel
infrastructure investment. Our analysis relies on a model of hydrocarbon production and
transportation, incorporating substitution between pipeline infrastructure and flexible
alternatives, like crude-by-rail. We apply the model to the Dakota Access Pipeline (DAPL),
which moves oil from North Dakota to Texas and was controversially completed in 2017. Had
DAPL’s construction been enjoined, we estimate that 82% of the blocked pipeline flows
would move by rail instead. This substitution induces both private costs and local
environmental damage, since rail transport imposes greater local externalities than
pipelines.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究旨在通过阻止化石燃料基础设施投资来“将碳留在地下”的政策。我们的分析依赖于一个烃类生产与运输模型，该模型纳入了管道基础设施与灵活替代方案（如原油铁路运输）之间的替代关系。我们将该模型应用于达科他输油管道（DAPL），该管道将石油从北达科他州输送至得克萨斯州，并于2017年颇具争议地完工。如果DAPL的建设曾被禁止，我们估计被阻止的管道流量中有82%将改为通过铁路运输。这种替代既带来私人成本，也带来地方环境损害，因为铁路运输施加的地方外部性大于管道。

papers.abstract_original:
I examine how disruptions to students’ environments propagate to their classmates to
understand mechanisms behind classroom peer interactions. I combine Chilean administrative
and survey data with housing-damage measures from one of history’s strongest earthquakes.
Damage to a student’s home lowered achievement and raised self-reported study effort cost.
Classmates’ average damage induced schools to reallocate resources toward student support
and increased achievement. In contrast, dispersion in classmates’ damage had heterogeneous
achievement effects that schools did not appear to mitigate, pointing to peer
interactions. Motivated by evidence suggesting students value classroom rank, I show that
a game-of-status model of grade competition rationalizes the findings. The results suggest
that, beyond production complementarities and conformity, a desire to compete could shape
peer effects on learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 我考察学生环境的扰动如何传导至其同学，以理解课堂同伴互动背后的机制。我将智利的行政数据和调查数据与历史上最强地震之一的住房受损度量相结合。学生自家住房受损降低了其成绩，并提高了其自报的学习努力成本。同学的平均受损程度促使学校将资源重新配置到学生支持上，并提高了成绩。相比之下，同学受损程度的离散度对成绩产生了异质性影响，而学校似乎并未对此加以缓解，这指向了同伴互动。受表明学生重视课堂排名的证据启发，我证明一个关于成绩竞争的地位博弈模型能够合理化这些发现。结果表明，除了生产互补性和从众之外，竞争意愿也可能塑造同伴对学习的影响。

papers.abstract_original: We study online platform business models where digital advertising is both informative and potentially manipulative. Sophisticated users correctly interpret ad signals, while naive users overestimate their informativeness. We characterize the platform’s profit-maximizing business model and show that advertising tends to reduce welfare for both groups. Naive users are overexposed to advertising and become too optimistic about product quality. The resulting increase in demand raises equilibrium prices for sophisticated users as well. Allowing the platform to offer multiple plans can intensify these welfare losses by separating naïfs and sophisticates. Similar results apply in the presence of firm-level and platform-level competition, because digital advertising softens competition. We conclude by showing how flat digital ad taxes can be welfare-improving.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究在线平台商业模式，其中数字广告既具有信息性又可能具有操纵性。精明的用户正确解读广告信号，而天真的用户则高估其信息性。我们刻画了平台利润最大化的商业模式，并表明广告往往会降低两类群体的福利。天真用户过度暴露于广告，并对产品质量变得过于乐观。由此带来的需求增加也提高了精明用户的均衡价格。允许平台提供多种方案可以通过将天真用户和精明用户分开而加剧这些福利损失。类似结果在企业层面和平台层面竞争存在时也适用，因为数字广告会软化竞争。最后，我们展示了统一的数字广告税如何能够改善福利。

papers.abstract_original: A quota mechanism, such as a mandatory grading curve, links together multiple decisions. We analyze the performance of quota mechanisms when the number of linked decisions is finite and the designer has imperfect knowledge of the type distribution. Using a new optimal transport approach, we derive an ex post decision error guarantee for quota mechanisms. This guarantee cannot be improved by any mechanisms without transfers. We quantify the sensitivity of quota mechanisms to errors in the designer’s estimate of the type distribution. Finally, we show that quotas are robust to a range of agents’ beliefs about each other.
papers.abstract_zh: 配额机制，例如强制性的评分曲线，将多个决策联系在一起。我们分析当相互关联的决策数量有限且设计者对类型分布了解不完美时，配额机制的表现。使用一种新的最优传输方法，我们推导出配额机制的事后决策误差保证。任何不包含转移支付的机制都无法改进这一保证。我们量化了配额机制对设计者类型分布估计误差的敏感性。最后，我们表明配额对代理人关于彼此的一系列信念具有稳健性。

papers.abstract_original: People predominantly talk within their identity groups. Conversations between majority-group members may, therefore, be crucial in shaping discrimination against minorities. In an experiment in India (N=3,397), nontransgender participants strongly discriminate against transgender workers when hiring for a grocery delivery, but a discussion with two nontransgender neighbors eliminates this discrimination in private postdiscussion choices. The discussion is 1.7 times more effective at reducing discrimination than information about transgender people’s legal rights, and effects partially persist after 1 month. The evidence is consistent with norm-based persuasion, in which pro-transgender participants are more vocal and create a perceived antidiscriminatory norm that reduces subsequent discrimination.
papers.abstract_zh: 人们主要在自己的身份群体内部交谈。因此，多数群体成员之间的对话可能对塑造针对少数群体的歧视至关重要。在印度的一项实验（N=3,397）中，非跨性别参与者在为杂货配送招聘时强烈歧视跨性别工人，但与两位非跨性别邻居的讨论在讨论后的私下选择中消除了这种歧视。该讨论在减少歧视方面比关于跨性别者法律权利的信息有效1.7倍，且效果在1个月后部分持续。证据与基于规范的劝说一致，即支持跨性别的参与者更敢于发声，并创造出一种感知到的反歧视规范，从而减少随后的歧视。

papers.abstract_original: I study competition between state regulators in the US life insurance industry. States compete for insurers by setting lower capital requirements, but the costs of such actions are partially borne by other states. I document states’ behaviors and insurers’ responses to this competition and its effects on life insurance supply. I develop a quantitative model of the insurance market that captures states’ competition and insurers’ responses. I find that competition leads regulators to set lower capital requirements, which increases default risks but increases consumer surplus by lowering prices. On net, competition between regulators decreases total surplus and redistributes across states.
papers.abstract_zh: 我研究美国寿险行业中州监管者之间的竞争。各州通过设定更低的资本要求来争夺保险公司，但此类行为的成本部分由其他州承担。我记录了各州的行为和保险公司对这种竞争的反应及其对寿险供给的影响。我构建了一个保险市场的定量模型，该模型刻画了各州的竞争和保险公司的反应。我发现竞争导致监管者设定更低的资本要求，这增加了违约风险，但通过降低价格增加了消费者剩余。净效应上，监管者之间的竞争降低了总剩余，并在各州之间进行了再分配。

papers.abstract_original: Optimal transportation policy depends on how demand elasticities interact across modes and vary across the population, but credible estimates are scarce. Partnering with Uber in Egypt, we randomize 3-month price discounts to study ride-hailing demand, total mobility, and external costs. A 50% discount more than quadruples Uber usage and raises total mobility by 49%. Effects are stronger for women, who are less mobile at baseline and perceive public transit as unsafe. Technology-induced declines in ride-hailing prices could generate user benefits of 6.1% of gross domestic product against external costs of 0.7%, with benefits accruing to the affluent and costs borne by everyone.
papers.abstract_zh: 最优交通政策取决于需求弹性在不同出行方式之间如何相互作用以及如何因人群而异，但可靠的估计结果十分稀缺。我们与优步在埃及合作，随机提供为期3个月的价格折扣，以研究网约车需求、总出行量及外部成本。50%的折扣使优步使用量增加四倍以上，并使总出行量提高49%。这一效应在女性中更强，她们在基线时出行更少，并认为公共交通不安全。技术导致的网约车价格下降可能带来相当于国内生产总值6.1%的用户收益，而外部成本为0.7%，其中收益归于富裕人群，成本则由所有人承担。
